summary: The change introduces a bounded unfinished-preservation diagnostic and emits it with the task id and a static reason at every null-returning preservation path, while preserving the existing custodian and state-write behavior.

evidence: ops/hosted-autonomy-blocked-candidate.ts:57-73 adds reportUnfinishedPreservation with taskId, bounded static reason, and optional truncated preserver error fields.
ops/hosted-autonomy-blocked-candidate.ts:143-205 reports binding_mismatch for all restore binding failures rather than silently returning null.
ops/hosted-autonomy-blocked-candidate.ts:229-350 reports distinct reasons for precheck, state availability/change, clock, ref, preserver, and CAS failures at every null return.
The previously silent successful-push/refused-CAS path now reports cas_not_applied at ops/hosted-autonomy-blocked-candidate.ts:347-350.
